summary: [FE][MT] Verify a typed Deck value is converted to the Master Data spelling when it is entered, in Edit Work Details and Edit Work Breakdown
description_wiki:
*Scenario:* Checks that a typed Deck value turns into the Master Data spelling when it is entered in Edit Work Details and Edit Work Breakdown.

*Precondition:* A user with View Worklist permission (see [Role & Permission|https://pttep.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/sites/TurnaroundManagement/Shared%20Documents/03%20Development/Role%20%26%20Permission%20V.2.xlsx?d=wa5e5a9a2071b4ed7b3ef83c4cf0dffd9&csf=1&web=1&e=3stFwC]) is logged in. {{Main Deck}} is a Master Data Deck value. Worklist {{WL-A}} holds works {{WK-1a}} and {{WK-1b}}, each with one Work Breakdown and Deck {{Helideck}}. The test runs for each of these rows (page, typed value): {{Edit Work Details}} of {{WK-1a}}, {{MAIN DECK}}; {{Edit Breakdown}} of {{WK-1b}} (Edit Work Breakdown page), {{mAiN dEcK}}.

*Navigation Path:* Planning tab > Plan Card > Worklist item > Worklist page of {{WL-A}} > the work > Edit Work Details, or Edit Work Breakdown.
